cells.name: uniform
cells.species: a uniform stream, direction from the knob

cells.name: source
cells.species: a point source (or sink), 1/r outward

cells.name: vortex
cells.species: a free vortex, 1/r around the center

cells.name: rankine
cells.species: Rankine vortex: solid-body core, free vortex outside
eq: w = r/a² for r < a,  w = 1/r for r ≥ a

cells.name: doublet
cells.species: a doublet — source and sink merged

cells.name: cylinder
cells.species: stream plus doublet plus circulation: flow past a cylinder with lift

cells.name: spiral_sink
cells.species: vortex plus sink: the drain

cells.name: taylor_green
cells.species: Taylor–Green vortex lattice

cells.name: shear
cells.species: a shear layer with a tanh profile, lightly perturbed

cells.name: dipole_pair
cells.species: two counter-rotating vortices — a vortex pair

cells.name: gravity
cells.species: the gravitational field of three orbiting masses (softened)

cells.name: coulomb
cells.species: the electric field of two charges, like or unlike

cells.name: magnetic_dipole
cells.species: the field of a magnetic dipole, slowly turning

cells.name: pendulum
cells.species: the pendulum's phase portrait: angle across, angular velocity up

cells.name: vanderpol
cells.species: van der Pol oscillator: every orbit spirals onto the limit cycle
eq: ẋ = y,  ẏ = μ(1 − x²)y − x

cells.name: duffing
cells.species: the Duffing oscillator, forced on hover

cells.name: lotka
cells.species: Lotka–Volterra predator–prey cycles
eq: ẋ = a·x − x·y,  ẏ = x·y − a·y

cells.name: hopf
cells.species: the Hopf normal form: a limit cycle is born as mu crosses zero

cells.name: saddle
cells.species: a saddle point, rotated

cells.name: lorenz
cells.species: the Lorenz flow projected onto (x, z)

cells.name: curl
cells.species: curl noise: the rotated gradient of fbm, divergence-free

cells.name: gradient
cells.species: the gradient of fbm: particles collect in the hills

cells.name: curl_plus_stream
cells.species: curl noise on top of a uniform stream

cells.name: wind
cells.species: two scales of curl noise plus a gusting stream — weather

cells.name: stagnation
cells.species: planar stagnation flow: streams meet and split

cells.name: source_vortex
cells.species: a source and a vortex together: an outward spiral

cells.name: vortex_street
cells.species: a Kármán vortex street: staggered counter-rotating vortices

cells.name: rankine_halfbody
cells.species: a uniform stream past a source: the Rankine half-body

cells.name: channel
cells.species: Poiseuille channel flow: a parabolic profile

cells.name: couette
cells.species: Couette flow: linear shear between plates

cells.name: stokeslet
cells.species: a Stokeslet: the Stokes flow of a point force

cells.name: jet
cells.species: a meandering confined jet

cells.name: double_vortex
cells.species: two co-rotating vortices, orbiting each other

cells.name: source_sink
cells.species: a source and a sink: flow from one to the other

cells.name: orbit
cells.species: gravity toward an orbiting mass, with a swirl

cells.name: charged_ring
cells.species: the field of a charged ring: out past it, in within

cells.name: two_body
cells.species: the gravity of a rotating binary

cells.name: node
cells.species: a node: both eigenvalues real, sign from the knobs

cells.name: spiral
cells.species: a linear focus: orbits spiral in or out

cells.name: limit_cycle
cells.species: a limit cycle at a set radius

cells.name: selkov
cells.species: the Sel'kov glycolysis oscillator

cells.name: brusselator
cells.species: the Brusselator reaction phase plane

cells.name: fitzhugh_ph
cells.species: the FitzHugh–Nagumo phase plane

cells.name: pitchfork
cells.species: the pitchfork normal form: one root splits into three

cells.name: sine_flow
cells.species: a sine flow: crossed sinusoids, an unsteady lattice

cells.name: abc_slice
cells.species: a slice of the ABC flow, slowly turning
eq: v = 0.3·(A sin z + C cos πy,  B sin πx + A cos z)

cells.name: perlin_curl
cells.species: large-scale curl noise: smooth marbling

cells.name: turbulent
cells.species: billowy curl noise off folded fbm
